name: longitudinal connected base plates
domain: 车辆轨道基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 沿线路纵向相连的底座板结构。

complete_examples.text: In numerical studies, different slab track types considering the unit and the longitudinal connected base plates are taken as illustrative and compara-tive examples, where the deformation coordinated mechanism of slab track-soil interaction and its influence on vehicle-induced vibrations are clarified.
